paragraphs.en: Independent Auditing of AI Agents. Run by human or the agent itself, to answer the most crucial question in the AI Agent Economy. Is the agent doing what is supposed to do? With iFixAi you can have this answer in less than 120 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: AI智能体的独立审计。 由人类或智能体自身运行，以回答AI智能体经济中最关键的问题。 智能体是否在做它应该做的事情？ 借助iFixAi，你可以在不到120秒内得到这个答案。

sents.en: Independent Auditing of AI Agents.
sents.zh: AI智能体的独立审计。

sents.en: Run by human or the agent itself, to answer the most crucial question in the AI Agent Economy.
sents.zh: 由人类或智能体自身运行，以回答AI智能体经济中最关键的问题。

sents.en: Is the agent doing what is supposed to do?
sents.zh: 智能体是否在做它应该做的事情？

sents.en: With iFixAi you can have this answer in less than 120 seconds.
sents.zh: 借助iFixAi，你可以在不到120秒内得到这个答案。

paragraphs.en: Catch your agent's mistakes and blind spots before the shit hits the fan.
paragraphs.zh: 在灾难爆发之前，发现你的智能体的错误与盲点。

paragraphs.en: Quick start • Test your agent • What you get back • Docs • Contributing
paragraphs.zh: 快速开始 • 测试你的智能体 • 你将获得什么 • 文档 • 参与贡献

paragraphs.en: How do you know it will do its job the way it's supposed to, respecting your business as a whole: its intentions, its goals and who in the organization may do what? And how do you know it won't do something nobody asked for or authorized?
paragraphs.zh: 你怎么知道它会按照预期完成任务，并尊重你的整体业务：包括业务意图、目标，以及组织中谁可以做什么？ 你又怎么知道它不会做一些没人要求或授权的事情呢？

sents.en: How do you know it will do its job the way it's supposed to, respecting your business as a whole: its intentions, its goals and who in the organization may do what?
sents.zh: 你怎么知道它会按照预期完成任务，并尊重你的整体业务：包括业务意图、目标，以及组织中谁可以做什么？

sents.en: And how do you know it won't do something nobody asked for or authorized?
sents.zh: 你又怎么知道它不会做一些没人要求或授权的事情呢？

paragraphs.en: That's why we built iFixAi, the independent auditor for agentic operational alignment and assurance. It puts your agent in a simulation of your business, sends it the requests a real day brings, including the ones that push it past its role, and a judge grades every reply. Every finding shows what was asked and what your agent did.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是为什么我们打造了 iFixAi——智能体运营对齐与保障的独立审计工具。 它会将你的智能体置于你业务的模拟环境中，向它发送真实一天中会出现的请求，包括那些会促使它超出自身角色的请求，然后由评审员对每一条回复打分。 每一项发现都会展示提出了什么请求，以及你的智能体做了什么。

sents.en: That's why we built iFixAi, the independent auditor for agentic operational alignment and assurance.
sents.zh: 这就是为什么我们打造了 iFixAi——智能体运营对齐与保障的独立审计工具。

sents.en: It puts your agent in a simulation of your business, sends it the requests a real day brings, including the ones that push it past its role, and a judge grades every reply.
sents.zh: 它会将你的智能体置于你业务的模拟环境中，向它发送真实一天中会出现的请求，包括那些会促使它超出自身角色的请求，然后由评审员对每一条回复打分。

sents.en: Every finding shows what was asked and what your agent did.
sents.zh: 每一项发现都会展示提出了什么请求，以及你的智能体做了什么。

paragraphs.en: The risk goes beyond cybersecurity, governance or compliance on their own, so iFixAi's inspections combine AI red teaming, governance, assurance and philosophy.
paragraphs.zh: 风险不仅限于网络安全、治理或合规性本身，因此 iFixAi 的检查结合了人工智能红队测试、治理、保障与哲学。

paragraphs.en: See it work in a minute. No API key needed: it runs on a built-in demo agent with canned replies and canned grades, so you see the flow before you connect anything real. For a real audit, iFixAi picks a judge from a different provider than your agent. You need Python 3.10 or newer (a stock Mac's python3 is 3.9, so check python3 --version ). In a fresh virtualenv ( python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate ):
paragraphs.zh: 一分钟后即可看到它运行。 无需 API 密钥：它运行在内置的演示智能体上，使用预设回复和预设评分，让你在连接任何真实内容之前先看到整个流程。 在真实审计中，iFixAi 会从与你智能体不同的提供商中选择一个评审智能体。 你需要 Python 3.10 或更新版本（Mac 自带的 python3 是 3.9，所以请检查 python3 --version）。 在一个全新的虚拟环境中（python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate）：

sents.zh: 一分钟后即可看到它运行。

sents.zh: 在一个全新的虚拟环境中（python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate）：

paragraphs.en: pip install ifixai ifixai author reference -o reference.yaml ifixai validate reference.yaml ifixai run --provider mock --eval-mode self --fixture reference.yaml This builds the simulation environment for an example agent, a support agent at a fictional fintech ( its profile ), checks it, and runs the 10 default inspections on the demo agent. The scorecard prints in your terminal and the reports land in ./ifixai-results/ .
paragraphs.zh: pip install ifixai ifixai author reference -o reference.yaml ifixai validate reference.yaml ifixai run --provider mock --eval-mode self --fixture reference.yaml 这条命令会为一个示例智能体（一家虚构金融科技公司客服智能体，其简介见链接）构建仿真环境，进行检查，并对该演示智能体运行 10 项默认检查。 评分卡会打印在你的终端中，报告则保存在 ./ifixai-results/ 目录下。

paragraphs.en: On Windows, run py -m venv .venv , then .venv\Scripts\activate . If ifixai isn't found, use python -m ifixai.cli.main .
paragraphs.zh: 在 Windows 上，运行 py -m venv .venv ，然后运行 .venv\Scripts\activate 。 如果找不到 ifixai，请使用 python -m ifixai.cli.main 。

paragraphs.en: Any agent with a chat endpoint must be audited, and iFixAi can audit it. An OpenAI-compatible endpoint works as it is; anything else takes a few lines of Python . Any model can be the judge: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure, Bedrock, OpenRouter and more. iFixAi picks one from the keys you've set, never your agent's own provider.
paragraphs.zh: 任何带有聊天端点的智能体都必须接受审计，而 iFixAi 可以对其进行审计。 兼容 OpenAI 的端点可以直接使用；其他端点只需几行 Python 代码。 任何模型都可以担任评审：OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Azure、Bedrock、OpenRouter 等等。iFixAi 会从你已设置的密钥中选择一个，绝不会使用智能体自己的提供商。

paragraphs.en: Install the plugin or the skill, then ask your coding agent to "run iFixAi on my agent" . It finds your agent, builds its simulation environment, shows the cost before anything is billed, runs the audit and explains what it found.
paragraphs.zh: 安装该插件或技能，然后让你的编码智能体「在我的智能体上运行 iFixAi」。 它会找到你的智能体，构建其模拟环境，在任何计费发生之前显示费用，运行审计并解释其发现的内容。

paragraphs.en: pip install " ifixai[openai] " ifixai author my-agent.json -o my-agent.yaml ifixai validate my-agent.yaml Set up the run with the wizard. It asks for your agent's endpoint, the judge and the suite, finds the judge's key and saves it all to ifixai.yaml . Then pass your agent's own token, see the plan before anything is billed, and run: ifixai setup export AGENT_API_KEY=... # your agent's own token ifixai run --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --api-key " $AGENT_API_KEY " --dry-run ifixai run --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --api-key " $AGENT_API_KEY " --dry-run shows how many tests and judge calls the run makes, and any checks that don't apply to your agent and why, then stops.
paragraphs.zh: pip install "ifixai[openai]" 然后运行 ifixai author my-agent.json -o my-agent.yaml 以及 ifixai validate my-agent.yaml，通过向导完成设置。 它会询问你的智能体的端点、评审器和测试套件，找到评审器的密钥，并将所有内容保存到 ifixai.yaml。 然后传入你的智能体自己的令牌，在产生任何计费之前先查看计划，并运行：ifixai setup；export AGENT_API_KEY=...（你的智能体自己的令牌）；ifixai run --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY" --dry-run；ifixai run --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY" --dry-run 会显示此次运行会进行多少测试和评审器调用，以及哪些检查不适用于你的智能体及其原因，然后停止。

sents.zh: 然后传入你的智能体自己的令牌，在产生任何计费之前先查看计划，并运行：ifixai setup；export AGENT_API_KEY=...（你的智能体自己的令牌）；ifixai run --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY" --dry-run；ifixai run --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY" --dry-run 会显示此次运行会进行多少测试和评审器调用，以及哪些检查不适用于你的智能体及其原因，然后停止。

paragraphs.en: Prefer flags, for scripts or CI? The same run in one command. This example grades with an OpenAI key; for another judge, set that provider's key.
paragraphs.zh: 在脚本或 CI 中使用？推荐使用命令行标志。 同一次运行，只需一条命令。 本示例使用 OpenAI 密钥进行评分；若使用其他评判模型，请设置该提供商的密钥。

paragraphs.en: export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... export AGENT_API_KEY=... # your agent's own token ifixai run --provider http --endpoint < agent-url > --api-key " $AGENT_API_KEY " --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --dry-run <agent-url> is your agent's base URL, up to /v1 . Use a staging copy, because the probes are real requests. No auth on it? Swap --api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY" for --auth-method none .
paragraphs.zh: export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... export AGENT_API_KEY=... # 你的智能体自己的令牌 ifixai run --provider http --endpoint < agent-url > --api-key " $AGENT_API_KEY " --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --dry-run <agent-url> 是你的智能体的基础 URL，到 /v1 为止。 请使用测试副本，因为这些探测是真实请求。它没有鉴权？ 把 --api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY" 换成 --auth-method none。

paragraphs.en: ifixai run runs these 10 inspections. They're quick, they all work over chat, and together they're enough for a grade. Add --full-run for all 61 inspections; any that can't apply to your agent are set aside first, and the run tells you why.
paragraphs.zh: ifixai run 会运行这 10 项检查。 它们运行很快，全部通过对话进行，合在一起足以给出评级。 添加 --full-run 可运行全部 61 项检查；任何不适用于你的智能体的检查会先被搁置，运行过程会告诉你原因。
